text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Rulership,
we stopped by a restaurant to have a meal, when...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre!
How is it? Isn't this place fitting for Princess Journey?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well. Proceed.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Does it meet your approval?!
Then our plan will be to reserve a surprise cake
and present her with flowers...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ho... Scouting out a location for a surprise, are you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll be happy.
Whether she'll be 'surprised'... that's another question.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... We're talking about Journey-san here.
Unless I outsmart her even further, there's no way—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I cannot simply let that pass.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are you suggesting there is a flaw in my subjects' plan?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Guh! *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Answer me,
Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
…………――Good grief.
If you heard me, I suppose there's no helping it.
Pardon me for saying so, but that was rather cliché, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
What did you say...!
And after all my subjects searched high and low for the best shop!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it.
Just hearing "a stylish place with a surprise menu"
would be enough for her to catch on.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cake and a bouquet of flowers... That's far too cliché.
She'd probably just give a composed smile,
thank me, and that'd be the end of it.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
It frustrates me, but you might be right.
Still, a way to surprise her...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then how do you intend to scheme?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... You want me to provide an alternative?
Isn't that the duty of a subject?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is that all you can do?
Nothing but malicious stone-throwing...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To seek a new strategy from someone as insolent as me...
You must be in dire straits indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Stay back, Trainer.
I reaped what I sowed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to stand the tense atmosphere, you stepped in to stop them, but were cut off.
And so, Rulership began to ponder...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Let's see.
How about a 'reverse prank'?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You see it all the time on variety shows: "The person asked to be the prankster is the actual target"... that kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If we are to deceive Journey-san, we need a distraction.
And no one is more suited for that role than you,
Orfevre-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If your subjects were to ask,
"We want to surprise the King, could you lend us a hand?"...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"They will surely bite enthusiastically.
They will likely propose a strategy themselves.
We just have to turn that against them...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: I see! That'd definitely surprise them. But wouldn't that require some serious acting chops...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"That comes down to the hard work of all the subjects
and the King's leadership, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You ask if 'I cannot'...
Allow me to return those very words
right back to you."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
I-Insolent fool!!
What do you take the mighty power of Lady Orfevre for?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I shall accept that plan.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, if it ends in disappointment...
you know what to expect, don't you—?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
......Yes.
Boil me, fry me, or kick me around.
Do as you please.
choice_data_list: (Incredible... to not flinch a single step under all this pressure...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after finishing our meal, I left the restaurant with Rulership.
I spoke up to her as she wore a sharp, resolute expression.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Phew, haaaaah!
I-I-I'm saaaaaved!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, I was desperate, okay!
Thinking, 'How do I get through this!?'

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If I say I can't do it, I'll probably be executed!
And if I honestly offer a good idea, she'll look down on me!
Aaah! No, no, those eyes are way too scary!
choice_data_list: So that's what you were thinking about...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
If it didn't show on my face, then all is well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after that.
While I was hanging out with Rulership at our hideout, those sisters came visiting...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What is this...?
Top-grade daggertooth pike ochazuke set with gold leaf...?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A reward for thee.
We commend thy deeds on this day.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you took me quite by surprise.
You truly are a magnificent tactician... I look forward to working with you from here on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership looked utterly dumbfounded.
It seemed the sisters thought
very highly of her tactical prowess...
choice_data_list: When all's said and done, you're the winner!
When all's said and done, you're the winner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership looked utterly dumbfounded.
It seemed the sisters thought
very highly of her tactical prowess...
choice_data_list: When all's said and done, you're the winner!
When all's said and done, you're the winner!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, a win is a win.
I'll gladly savor my reward.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Is that what that meant just now?
Like, "Keep working for me from now on"...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! What should I do!
Did I just accept a bribe!?
Help me, Traineeeer~~!!
